purpose: Explore local structured data through bounded observations and reusable fixed results. The caller chooses the questions and judges the evidence.
start: rowtrail demo --directory ./rowtrail-demo (optional offline stdlib Python demo)
rowtrail schema METHOD (only for an unfamiliar operation)
workflow: Open CSV/TSV/Parquet; keep the response binding and fields. Open does not perform a full profile.
Search wide schema names with inspect.search; context inspection recovers purpose, SQL and fixed inputs without scanning data. Choose explicit columns for scanning checks.
Check ok, then job.state. Read an included observation directly; do not fetch it again.
For follow-up SQL, bind result_ref plus a fixed revision. Keep large tables outside model context.
For progressive Parquet count/sum/avg, use analyze. Its observations cover only the reported prefix; ordinary SQL is preferable for final-only answers.
A fresh conversation can discover existing bindings and active jobs with workspace summary. Pass its cursor unchanged to get the next page.
Use control wait/status/cancel and durable events. Mechanical waiting needs no model. Disconnecting does not cancel accepted work.
Release unused results, inspect workspace gc dry-run, then explicitly apply collection. Retained descendants protect their inputs.
quality: Read accuracy, coverage, final_for_request and presentation separately. Completing a query on a partial result does not make its original-source coverage complete.
numbers: Int64, UInt64 and Decimal are JSON strings with declared types. SQL integer/Decimal SUM is checked (numeric policy rowtrail-numeric-v1); Decimal output precision is checked. Other SQL arithmetic retains engine semantics. accuracy=exact describes sampling, not arbitrary-precision arithmetic. Old missing policies are unknown. Progressive avg is Decimal128(38,6), truncated toward zero.
budgets: Waiting, computation, memory, scanning, stored results and output have separate limits. Engine memory is not a process RSS hard cap.
retry: After ambiguous transport failure, control lookup with ref=idempotency_key reads committed acceptance without replay. Missing is a point-in-time observation, not proof an in-flight request cannot commit. Never silently replay mutations.
capabilities: Use doctor for actual capabilities. Client and coordinator versions must match; close old sessions and allow idle exit before upgrading. Stable workspace endpoints do not depend on TMPDIR. No internal model calls or automatic host resume.
composition: Use the optional stdlib client with response_mode="compact". query(fetch=False) retains an intermediate without displaying rows; context(binding) retrieves saved meaning. Compose known steps and print only bounded evidence. query consumes final wait observations and never replays a request.
analysis: Native snapshot creates an independent managed copy with bounded caller provenance. Optional stdlib helpers provide checks, keyed diff, recipes and portable branch packages; see docs/analysis.md. Higher-level composition is Python-only .
compact: Request response_mode=compact (CLI --compact; MCP _request.response_mode) omits operational detail, preserving full quality, types, errors, fixed bindings and truncation. control/status retains metrics; control/wait.output can return a bounded answer directly. row_count is the committed revision count, not original-source coverage.
